senses.sense_definition: A standard measure of the performance or anti-knock quality of motor fuel; octane rating or octane number.

examples.text: This sports car requires gasoline with a higher <w>octane</w> to run smoothly.
The driver checked the <w>octane</w> rating before filling up the tank.

senses.sense_definition: A saturated liquid hydrocarbon of the alkane series found in petroleum, containing eight carbon atoms.

examples.text: During the laboratory experiment, the students measured the boiling point of pure <w>octane</w>.
Petroleum refineries blend various hydrocarbons, including <w>octane</w>, to formulate commercial fuels.
